scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check:deno: deno check --cached-only --config tests/runtime/deno.json tests/runtime/application-context.deno.ts tests/runtime/core.deno.ts tests/runtime/permissions.deno.ts && deno test --cached-only --no-prompt --config tests/runtime/deno.json tests/runtime/application-context.deno.ts tests/runtime/core.deno.ts tests/runtime/permissions.deno.ts
scripts.build: npm run check:architecture && vite build && node scripts/build-core-probe.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:architecture && npm test && npm run check:deno && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
